business_summary: Motic (Xiamen) Electric Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of insulation products and other related components for the power transmission and transformation industry in China and internationally. It operates through Electrical Business, Optical Business, and Medical Business segments. The Electrical Business segment is involved in the production and sales of insulation products and other related components; and technical research and development, and operation of the energy internet. The Optical Business segment manufactures and sells instruments, meters, electronic products, optical, mechanical, electrical integrated products, microscope system integration, and other products. The Medical Business segment produces and sells medical testing products; and provides medical diagnostic services. The company offers three-phase or single-phase basin insulators, insulating tie rods, sealed terminals, sealed poles, bushings, and post insulator products. It also provides insulation components for magnetic levitation and electrified railways. Motic (Xiamen) Electric Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
